name: Sleeping Goddess Strike (Combat)
body:
Your strikes forge a temporary connection with the target, through which you can affect them more strongly.

Prerequisites: Sleeping Goddess Style, Sleeping Goddess Slumber, Autohypnosis 11 ranks.

Benefit: Whenever you hit an opponent with an attack, they take a –2 penalty on saving throws against your maneuvers until the end of their next turn.
